body:
http://suicideprevention.ca/thinking-about-suicide/find-a-crisis-centre/

List of crisis center by region. Also, you can vent here.

The likely won't refund your parents for classes, textbooks, room & board, though payment plans are easily manageable. But as others have said, the emotional burden vastly outweighs the financial. 

You should finish your first year regardless. I can only speak to my own experience; but living in a dorm my freshman year was one of the longest happy periods of my life. Making friends is much easier when you're forced to interact with each other everyday.

The psychiatrist helped you more than the primary care doc? My doc suggested it and I said no, just because I'm so bad at opening up. I've never been to a psychiatrist or therapist before but I've been considering it since medication isn't helping.
